cohort: 1042 women referred to a pelvic floor unit in a tertiary Spanish hospital between 2008 and 2012
finding: The study found differences in potential triggers and risk factors for POP and SUI, with cesarean section and pelvic floor rehabilitation having a protective effect on POP.
mod_finding: Cesarean section reduces the risk of POP by three-fold, while forceps delivery and vaginal tears were more common in the POP group.
birth_weight: Newborn weight was recorded, with heavier newborns observed in the POP group
cross-section timing: At first visit to pelvic floor unit
